issues.issue: Was the RPD's choice of reavailment (s.108(1)(a)) over changed circumstances (s.108(1)(e)) justified, given its collateral consequences?
issues.applicant_position: The RPD had to justify choosing reavailment, given loss of PR status and inadmissibility, over changed circumstances.
issues.respondent_position: The Minister relied only on reavailment; no respondent submissions on collateral consequences are set out.
issues.result_quote: provided the requisite degree of justification, intelligibility and transparency, even considering all that was at stake for Ms. Ravandi.

issues.issue: Did the RPD have to consider changed circumstances (s.108(1)(e)) once it found reavailment?
issues.applicant_position: The RPD had to consider changed circumstances; the uncontradicted evidence of the father's imprisonment required it.
issues.result_quote: I am not persuaded that, having found refugee protection had ceased because of reavailment, the RPD member was required to go on to consider changed circumstances.
